As summarised by PwC (review of 10 September 2026), not checked against the Federal Public Service Finance.

instruments.explanation: The National Tax List gives one set of lines for the personal income tax (EUR 73.9 billion in the lines drawn here). Eurostat’s accounts place EUR 13.3 billion with the regions and communities and EUR 4.1 billion with local government (the municipal surcharges); this row is the rest, under the federal government.
